text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Phew, phew... Did we manage to finish it somehow?
More importantly, Kanon-san!
During the battle, you tried to attack me several times, didn't you!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
なんとか終わりましたかね……
それよりも、ちょっとカノンさん！
戦闘中、
何度も私ごと攻撃しようとしてましたよね！？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that so?
Weren't you just mesmerized by my splendid attacks and came into them like a butterfly attracted to flower nectar?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
らそうでしたかしら？
アナタがあたくし様の華麗な攻撃に見とれて、
花の蜜に集る
おバタフライの如く当たりに来てしまったのではなくて？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
There's no way that's true!
We defeated the enemies, but it seems the battle isn't over yet...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなわけがないでしょうっ！
敵は倒しましたけど、
戦いはまだ終わってないみたいですね……！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, are you up for it?
I don't mind at all!
I still haven't thanked you for tying me up with threads and throwing me at the enemies earlier!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
フン、
やる気ですの？
あたくしは全然かまわなくってよ！
先ほど糸で縛って敵にブン投げてくださったお礼もまだですし！？
